content.h2: What web hosting with no renewal price increase means for a business
content.answer: Business hosting at DronaHost has no renewal price increase. Every plan renews at the price you signed up for, with no end date. For busier and larger sites of any kind, WordPress or not, Pro gives you semi-dedicated resources and Scale gives you dedicated resources. The plan cards on this page show every price, and the table below adds up what each plan costs over three years.

content.h2: Between WordPress hosting and a VPS
content.answer: WordPress hosting covers small business sites built on WordPress. A VPS suits you when you need root access and want to run your own server. Business hosting sits between the two. Pro gives you semi-dedicated resources and Scale gives you dedicated resources, for any kind of site, with no server to run. You manage files, databases, apps and backups in a control panel.

items.q: Will my price go up at renewal?
items.a: No. Every plan renews at the same price you signed up for, and that price has no end date. The plan cards on this page show the signup price and the renewal price side by side, so you see both before you buy. Prices exclude tax. Customers in India pay GST at checkout.

items.q: What happens when my site gets busier?
items.a: Choose a plan with room to grow. Pro adds semi-dedicated resources and performance tuning. Scale adds dedicated resources and more CPU cores and memory than any other plan; the plan cards list each figure. If your site needs more than Scale, high-traffic and dedicated plans are scoped with the team and have no published price.

items.q: How many websites can I host?
items.a: The number depends on the plan. Pro holds up to 25 websites and 50 databases. On Scale, websites, domains and databases are under fair use rather than a fixed number. Each plan card on this page shows the limits for websites, storage, CPU cores and memory, so you can compare them.

items.q: How do you move my site?
items.a: We move one website for free on every plan. You share access to your current hosting, and we copy your site to DronaHost while your old site keeps serving visitors. We ask your permission before anything is switched. Then your DNS points to DronaHost, and the move is complete. The migration terms explain what the move covers.

Support runs 24/7 by ticket and email. Open a ticket or send an email, and you get a written reply, so you keep a record of every answer. Growth adds priority support, and Scale adds senior experts. The support policy sets out the full terms, including what support covers.

items.q: How is business hosting different from WordPress hosting?
items.a: Business hosting and WordPress hosting use the same four plans. The WordPress hosting page is written for WordPress sites. This page is for any kind of site, WordPress or not, and points growing and larger sites to Pro and Scale. Choose by the size and needs of your site, not by the name of the page.

items.q: Which currency are prices shown in?
items.a: Prices show in US dollars, British pounds, euros, UAE dirhams or Indian rupees. The currency follows your choice or your location, and you can change it with the currency selector. The same plans and prices apply in every country; only the currency changes. Prices exclude tax. Customers in India pay GST at checkout.
